description: Turn off Apple Intelligence and delete its models on your Mac. Optional tweaks for analytics, ads and pop-ups. A native app and CLI, and every change can be undone.

latest_release.name: v1.1.4
latest_release.body:
- `removemacai undo` with no tweak names now asks you to name them, the way `apply` does, instead of saying nothing needs changing (#57). Contributed by cosmicsid004 in #64.
- Commands no longer accept words and options they don't use, and `--keep` with nothing after it says it needs feature names (#58). Contributed by sean0407 in #62.
- Remove unused Apple apps from the Dock now also takes Image Playground and Journal off the Dock (#63).

detail.readme_excerpt:
# RemoveMacAI Turn off Apple Intelligence and delete its models. The app starts with just that. If you want to debloat further, it can also stop the analytics and ads, quiet the pop-ups, switch off other apps' background updaters and get disk space back. You see every change before it happens, and every change can be undone.

omlahore.github.io/RemoveMacAI

Built on [pared](https://github.com/4evy/pared) by 4evy, who did the hard work first: mapping Apple's asset service, the model sets and the settings keys the Apple Intelligence part relies on. [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004672/mac-delete-apple-intelligence-ai-tool), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/apple/2026/10/command-line-tool-quickly-removes-apple-intelligence-from-macos-27/), [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/10/05/get-rid-of-apples-ai-bloatware-and-reclaim-12-gb-of-storage-with-this-open-source-tool/5301213), [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/10/05/apple-intelligence-removal-tool-frees-mac-storage/), [AppleInsider](https://appleinsider.com/articles/26/10/05/dumb-down-your-mac-save-12gb-by-removing-apple-intelligence) and [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/10/05/removemacai-turn-off-apple-intelligence/) have written about RemoveMacAI, and [Daring Fireball](https://daringfireball.net/linked/2026/10/06/cli-tool-removes-apple-intelligence-from-macos-27) linked to it. ## Install ### The app Open Terminal (Applications > Utilities), paste this line and press Return: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omlahore/RemoveMacAI/main/install.sh | bash -s app ``` It downloads the latest release, checks its SHA-256 checksum, puts RemoveMacAI in Applications and opens
